message: fix(runtime): register the value tier's public surface and correct its guide

edits.replace:
// older name. Phase 6 of that issue then added `values`, the value tier's transaction
    // beside `edit`. Nothing else moved.

edits.find: - **Runtime surface work landed, phases 2 through 5 of [#362](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/362):** [#365](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/365) and [#366](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/366) are merged. `motionIds()`, `freeTrackIds()` and `mountedNodeIds()` on `ProjectHandle` answer frozen, total arrays in committed order, both demos mount from the runtime's own answer instead of a hand-written id list beside the document, and `#ownedBy` widened by one parameter so the free half and `MotionHandle.trackIds` read one ownership filter. `ProjectHandle.subscribe`, `adopt` and `destroyAdopted` are then deleted with no alias, which takes `TrackEntry.owner`, the `#schemaOwner` sentinel and `#addTrack`'s `owner` parameter out of `ProjectRuntime` with them, and the wrong `MotionHandle.signal` line is corrected in both guide documents that carried it. `RA-145` through `RA-157`. ADR-076 records the removal and ADR-020 is superseded rather than left contradicting it. [#367](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/367) then refuses `mountAll` and `unmountAll` on a measurement rather than adding them, so phase 5 ships four cases and no runtime code: the membership revision is the key the publisher snapshot's memo is compared against rather than an invalidation, and that snapshot is derived inside `flush` and nowhere else, so `n` mounts before one flush already derive one. `RA-158` through `RA-161`, recorded in ADR-077.
edits.replace: - **Runtime surface work landed, phases 2 through 5 of [#362](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/362):** [#365](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/365), [#366](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/366) and [#367](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/pull/367) are merged. `motionIds()`, `freeTrackIds()` and `mountedNodeIds()` enumerate a loaded project in committed order and both demos mount from those answers instead of a hand-written id list; `subscribe`, `adopt` and `destroyAdopted` are deleted with no alias, which takes `TrackEntry.owner` and the `#schemaOwner` sentinel with them; `mountAll` and `unmountAll` are refused on a measurement rather than added, so phase 5 ships four cases and no runtime code. `RA-145` through `RA-161`. ADR-076 records the removal, ADR-020 is superseded rather than left contradicting it, and ADR-077 records the refusal.

edits.find: which covers `seek`, `invalidate`, `mount`, `unmount`, `signal`, `setTrigger`, `setStagger` reached on the handle itself, and a second `values`.
edits.replace: which covers `invalidate`, `mount`, `unmount`, `signal`, and `setTrigger` and `setStagger` reached on the handle itself, and a second `values`. `seek` is deliberately not one of them: it is a value verb, so inside a batch it stages its own node and joins the one publication exactly as the other four do.
